# Spot-light HD

> A realistic browser game: Spot, a two-year-old black labrador with a red collar, chases a laser dot the player steers with a mouse, finger, keyboard or gamepad. Three furnished places, seven game modes, photo mode, synthesised sound. One self-contained index.html built with three.js and Vite. MIT licence.

- Modes: Dodge, Endless, Lure, Fetch, Zoomies, Hide & seek, Relax.
- Places: living room, garden, snowy cabin; day, evening or night; clear, rain or snow in the garden.
- No network requests besides Google Fonts; settings and scores stay in the browser's localStorage.
